id: 09_Test Your Knowledge of Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) Job Safety Analysis (JSA) MCQs
title: 工作危害分析十问
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/09_Test Your Knowledge of Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) Job Safety Analysis (JSA) MCQs.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/09_Test Your Knowledge of Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) Job Safety Analysis (JSA) MCQs/src.py

points.K3: 先回顾事故和未遂记录
points.K7: 让做这项工作的人参与
points.K10: 优先分析出过事的作业

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，手拿一张空白分析表，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a laboratory door holding a blank analysis sheet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天用十道题，学会工作危害分析。

shots.scene: 一行图标：分解的台阶、放大镜、盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A row of three simple icons: a staircase of steps, a magnifying glass and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 拆步骤、找危害、定措施，一步不落。

shots.scene: 阿杰抱起一个沉重的铸件，弯着腰
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends deeply at the waist to pick up a heavy metal casting from the workshop floor.
shots.narration: 阿杰要弯腰抬起一个铸件。

shots.scene: 老周走过来，按住铸件，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks over, puts a hand on the casting and shakes his head kindly.
shots.narration: 老周拦住他：先做危害分析再动手。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a big question mark above him.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：危害分析到底怎么做？

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一张空白卡片，上面画着问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card with a question mark pictogram and smiles.
shots.narration: 我们边答题边学，一共十道。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一个实验台，四周有四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a lab bench surrounded by four floating icons: a map pin, a person, a lightning spark and a warning triangle.
shots.narration: 第一题：描述危害要讲清哪几个方面？

shots.scene: 地图定位图标落在实验台的一角
shots.prompt_en: A map pin icon lands on one corner of a lab bench near the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 环境：危害在哪里发生。

shots.scene: 人形图标被箭头指向
shots.prompt_en: An arrow points at a simple person icon standing beside the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 暴露：会伤到谁，或损坏什么。

shots.scene: 一只脚踢到纸箱的图标，闪光
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a foot catching on a box on the floor with a small flash. No people.
shots.narration: 触发：是什么动作或条件引发了它。

shots.scene: 警示三角下面画一个摔倒的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A yellow warning triangle above a simple icon of a falling person. No people.
shots.narration: 后果：不加控制，最可能出什么事。

shots.scene: 四个图标合拢成一个整圆，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Four icons join together into one complete circle with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 答案E，以上都是，都要考虑。

shots.scene: 三张卡片：盾牌、法槌、扫帚
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards in a row showing a shield icon, a judge gavel icon and a broom icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：做危害分析，图的是什么？

shots.scene: 法槌卡片打红叉
shots.prompt_en: The gavel card is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不是给上级处分员工找依据。

shots.scene: 扫帚卡片打红叉
shots.prompt_en: The broom card is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也不是给轻岗人员找点事做。

shots.scene: 盾牌卡片亮起，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The shield card glows with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，消除和预防工作中的危害。

shots.section_title: 先回顾事故和未遂记录
shots.scene: 一叠空白记录本，上面有感叹号图标
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank record books with a yellow exclamation icon on top. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：要不要先翻以往的事故记录？
overlay: 先回顾事故和未遂记录

shots.section_title: 先回顾事故和未遂记录
shots.scene: 欣欣点头，翻开记录本
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and opens a blank record book.
shots.narration: 答案A，正确。

shots.section_title: 先回顾事故和未遂记录
shots.scene: 记录本里两个图标：受伤的绷带、差点摔倒的人
shots.prompt_en: Inside the book two icons: a bandage and a person nearly slipping but catching balance. No people.
shots.narration: 受过伤的、差点出事的，都要看。

shots.section_title: 先回顾事故和未遂记录
shots.scene: 小研在平面图红点处画圈
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student circles the red spot on the floor plan with a marker.
shots.narration: 先把重点放在这些地方。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着防护罩图标的卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a card showing a machine guard icon.
shots.narration: 第四题：工程控制是最有效的控制吗？

shots.scene: “正确”的卡片亮起打勾
shots.prompt_en: A card with a large green check mark lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，正确。

shots.scene: 通风柜和防护罩图标，一个大拇指
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fume hood and a machine guard with a thumbs up icon. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制被认为是最有效的控制形式。

shots.scene: 三张卡片，第三张画着台阶、放大镜和盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards; the third shows a staircase, a magnifying glass and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：危害分析的基本思路是什么？

shots.scene: 实验流程被切成一节一节的方块
shots.prompt_en: A long arrow representing a lab task is cut into several numbered blocks without text. No people.
shots.narration: 第一，把作业拆成一个个步骤。

shots.scene: 放大镜依次扫过每个方块
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass moves over each block one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，逐个步骤找出危害。

shots.scene: 每个方块旁边出现一个小盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A small shield appears beside each block. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，为每个危害定好控制措施。

shots.scene: 小研把三栏分析表贴在实验台旁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pins a blank three-column analysis sheet on the wall beside a lab bench.
shots.narration: 步骤、危害、措施，三栏对应。

shots.scene: 另两张卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two other cards are crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，另两项都不对。

shots.scene: 阿杰弯腰抬起地上的铸件
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends down to lift a metal casting from the floor.
shots.narration: 第六题：弯腰抬15磅铸件，怎么描述？

shots.scene: 三张图标卡片：插头火花、腰部红点、振动波纹
shots.prompt_en: Three cards: a sparking plug icon, a human back with a red spot at the lower back, and a vibration wave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 触电、腰背劳损、振动伤神经？

shots.scene: 火花和振动卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: The sparking plug card and the vibration card are crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 抬铸件不涉及电火花和振动。

shots.scene: 人体侧影，下背部红色高亮，伴有扭转箭头
shots.prompt_en: A side silhouette of a person bending and twisting with the lower back highlighted in red and a curved twisting arrow.
shots.narration: 伸手、扭身，容易拉伤下背部。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头，指着腰部卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and points at the lower back card.
shots.narration: 答案B，弯腰抬东西会伤到下背部。

shots.section_title: 让做这项工作的人参与
shots.scene: 老周一个人坐在办公桌前填表，打叉
shots.prompt_en: The older man fills in a form alone at an office desk; a red X appears over the scene.
shots.narration: 第七题：只让负责人来做，对吗？
overlay: 让做这项工作的人参与

shots.section_title: 让做这项工作的人参与
shots.scene: 欣欣摇头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head.
shots.narration: 答案B，错误。

shots.section_title: 让做这项工作的人参与
shots.scene: 阿杰在实验台边比划操作动作，老周认真记录
shots.prompt_en: The young male student demonstrates how he does a task at the bench while the older man takes notes.
shots.narration: 天天动手的人，最清楚哪里危险。

shots.section_title: 让做这项工作的人参与
shots.scene: 阿杰指着工具，提出一条建议，灯泡亮起
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at a tool and a light bulb appears above his head.
shots.narration: 也最知道该加什么预防措施。

shots.scene: 一张填空卡，三个空格
shots.prompt_en: A blank card with three empty boxes in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：危害分析是什么？

shots.scene: 第一个空格填入放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon drops into the first box. No people.
shots.narration: 它是辨识危害的方法，

shots.scene: 第二个空格填入切开的方块图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a block cut into pieces drops into the second box. No people.
shots.narration: 是把作业分解开来的手段，

shots.scene: 第三个空格填入一群人看警示牌的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of several people looking at a warning triangle drops into the third box. No people.
shots.narration: 也帮大家看懂身边的危害。

shots.scene: 一个人独自在角落里填表，头上满是问号
shots.prompt_en: A single person icon sits alone in a corner filling a form, surrounded by question marks. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：一个人做，就不会混乱？

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head.
shots.narration: 答案B，错误，要让团队参与。

shots.scene: 老周、小研、阿杰、王老师围桌讨论
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student, the young male student and the safety administrator discuss around a table.
shots.narration: 负责人、学生、安全员一起看。

shots.scene: 问号逐个消失，变成勾
shots.prompt_en: Question marks above the table turn into check marks one by one.
shots.narration: 多双眼睛，漏掉的危害更少。

shots.section_title: 优先分析出过事的作业
shots.scene: 几张作业卡片排队，其中一张带绷带图标
shots.prompt_en: Several blank task cards in a line; one card has a bandage icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：先分析出过事的作业吗？
overlay: 优先分析出过事的作业

shots.section_title: 优先分析出过事的作业
shots.scene: 欣欣点头，把带绷带的卡片拿到最前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and moves the bandage card to the front of the line.
shots.narration: 答案A，正确，出过事的排第一。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands by a whiteboard with four icons: steps, magnifier, shield and people.
shots.narration: 拆步骤、找危害、定措施、全员参与。

shots.scene: 记录本和带绷带的卡片
shots.prompt_en: A blank record book and a task card with a bandage icon. No people.
shots.narration: 翻事故和未遂记录，出过事的先分析。

shots.scene: 防护罩图标和腰部图标
shots.prompt_en: A machine guard icon and a lower back icon. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制最有效，弯腰抬物伤下背。

shots.scene: 老周在分析表上签字，众人点头
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs the analysis sheet while the others nod.
shots.narration: 不让主管一人做，也不一个人做。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a tidy workshop.
shots.narration: 先分析再动手，下次见！
